Thumbnail images for publications (optional).

Put a small figure or teaser image here, e.g. a result figure from the paper,
then reference it in content/publications.bib by adding one line to that entry:

    image = {img/pubs/gunasekara2021systematic.png},

A good habit is to name the file after the BibTeX key. Any size works; it's
shown in a 4:3 box about 150px wide. If a paper has no image, a small venue
tag (e.g. "ICIIS") is shown in its place instead — so images are never required.
